selected_primary_reviews.version_note: Revision 1 (2025-09-17) clarifies advice semantics; revision 2 removes an unused flawed claim. No discarded claim is used here.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Symmetric Exponential Time Requires Near-Maximum Circuit Size
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Circuit lower bounds for S2E/1.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: S2E with advice is outside the selected roster. The title does not give an E or NE lower bound.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Symmetric Exponential Time Requires Near-Maximum Circuit Size: Simplified, Truly Uniform
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Near-maximum circuit lower bounds for S2E, eliminating the advice in earlier work.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Eliminating advice does not eliminate symmetric alternation. No new E/NE/NEXP pair follows.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Exponential-Size Circuit Complexity is Comeager in Symmetric Exponential Time
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Resource-bounded category lower bounds inside symmetric exponential time.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: This refines a lower bound for a class outside the roster; it does not place the hard language in NE or NEXP.

selected_primary_reviews.title: A note on a hierarchy theorem for promise-BPTIME
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: A time hierarchy for promise randomized computation.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The promise qualifier prevents importing a hierarchy for total-language BPP or a new NEXP versus BPP separation.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Range avoidance, Arthur-Merlin, and TFNP
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Decision problems reducible to range avoidance lie in AM intersect coAM; NP-hardness of avoidance would collapse PH.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Conditional hardness and a restricted reduction target do not give NP contained in coAM as an unconditional fact.

selected_primary_reviews.title: On Oracles and Algorithmic Methods for Proving Lower Bounds
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Algorithmic lower-bound connections and relativized limits of these methods.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Oracle statements and conditional missing-string algorithms do not settle an ordinary roster pair.
selected_primary_reviews.version_note: The public page carries an erratum: conference Theorem 1.10 is incorrect and its negation can be proved. That conference claim is not used.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Lower Bounds from Succinct Hitting Sets
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Hypotheses about succinct hitting sets yield alternatives involving arithmetic lower bounds and P versus PSPACE.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The auxiliary arithmetic hypotheses and disjunctions are not unconditional roster separations.

selected_primary_reviews.title: On the usefulness of Promises
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Promise constraint-satisfaction classification, including statements conditional on P not equal NP.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: A promise-CSP classification is not a containment or separation of all languages in two roster classes.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Counting Martingales for Measure and Dimension in Complexity Classes
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Counting-resource dimension bounds for randomized/quantum classes and circuit bounds higher in exponential hierarchies.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Measure/dimension zero is not an ordinary class noninclusion; exponential-hierarchy lower bounds do not descend automatically to NEXP or PP.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Total Search Problems in ZPP
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: TFZPP and black-box total-search separations.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Search relations and black-box models do not settle total-language ZPP containment questions.

selected_primary_reviews.title: On the approximation method and the P versus NP problem
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Limitations and analysis of the approximation method.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The paper does not claim an unconditional resolution of P versus NP.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Reverse Mathematics of Complexity Lower Bounds
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Lower-bound provability in bounded arithmetic, including PV1 and APC1.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Bounded-arithmetic unprovability is not independence of a class inclusion from ZFC.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Meta-Mathematics of Computational Complexity Theory
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: An author survey of bounded-arithmetic approaches to complexity lower bounds.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: No claim that an ordinary roster inclusion has been proved independent of ZFC is supplied.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Student-Teacher Constructive Separations and (Un)Provability in Bounded Arithmetic: Witnessing the Gap
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Constructive separations, witnessing, and bounded-arithmetic proof uniformity.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The metatheory is weaker than ZFC and the constructive hypotheses do not settle a new unconditional roster pair.

selected_primary_reviews.title: A Theory for Probabilistic Polynomial-Time Reasoning
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Arithmetic theories for probabilistic and promise computation.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: A theory capturing probabilistic reasoning is not an unconditional derandomization or ZFC-independence result.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Limit on the computational power of C-random strings
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Oracle computation from plain Kolmogorov-random strings for a selected universal decompressor.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The halting problem and nonrecursive randomness oracle are outside the ordinary recursive roster; no oracle can be suppressed.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Hilbert’s Nullstellensatz is in the Counting Hierarchy
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: An improved upper bound for a particular problem, from PSPACE to the counting hierarchy.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The problem is not shown PSPACE-complete, and CH is not PP. This does not imply PSPACE contained in PP.

selected_primary_reviews.title: How to Construct Random Strings
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Random-string constructions conditional on quantified time/advice hardness.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The hardness hypotheses are assumptions, not newly proved E/NE/EXP/NEXP noninclusions.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Towards Free Lunch Derandomization from Necessary Assumptions (and OWFs)
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Fast derandomization and hard-to-find errors under distributional hardness or cryptographic assumptions.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The required assumptions and allowed errors do not prove total-language BPP equal P.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Gödel in Cryptography: Effectively Zero-Knowledge Proofs for NP with No Interaction, No Setup, and Perfect Soundness
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: A relaxed effective zero-knowledge notion based on logical inability to establish simulator failure, under conjectures.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Effective zero knowledge is not statistical zero knowledge. Neither NP contained in SZK nor ZFC independence of a roster pair follows.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Equality cases of Alexandrov–Fenchel inequality are not in polynomial hierarchy
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: If the stated equality problem is in PH, then PH collapses to a finite level.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The theorem is conditional despite the title. It does not unconditionally separate CeqP from PH.

selected_primary_reviews.title: The Entangled Quantum Polynomial Hierarchy Collapses
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: An entangled quantum hierarchy collapses to QRG(1), a class contained in PSPACE; a distribution hierarchy equals PH.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: These auxiliary hierarchies differ from the ordinary polynomial hierarchy and roster QMA. Its ordinary upper bounds are already present.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Improved separation between quantum and classical computers for sampling and functional tasks
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Sampling/function consequences and a conditional collapse from P^#P equal BPP with parallel NP queries to its zero-error counterpart.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Sampling separation and the specified counting-oracle equality do not unconditionally separate decision BQP from BPP.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Jump Operators, Interactive Proofs and Proof Complexity Generators
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Jump operators for proof systems and conditional proof-complexity consequences.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: These propositional proof-system transformations do not prove MA contained in NP or a ZFC-independence statement.
selected_primary_reviews.date_precision_note: Conference opening date, used only as a pre-cutoff latest publication bound; no assertion about the first preprint day.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Efficient Adversaries
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Constructive lower bounds for restricted propositional proof systems; conditional consequences for Extended Frege.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Efficient adversaries here are proof-complexity game strategies. No unconditional ordinary class separation follows from the conditional Extended Frege claim.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Faux Determinism
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Black-box search algorithms computationally indistinguishable from deterministic behavior to bounded adversaries.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The search/query setting and computational indistinguishability do not establish P equal BPP or P equal ZPP.

selected_primary_reviews.title: The Oracle Derandomization Hypothesis is False (And More) Assuming No Natural Proofs
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Consequences of an NP-natural-proofs conjecture, including failure of oracle derandomization.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The conjectural hypothesis, oracle setting and effective zero-knowledge notion prevent importing a known ordinary roster label.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Towards EXPTIME One Way Functions Bloom Filters, Succinct Graphs & Self Masking
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Proposed one-way constructions with black-boxed hash functions and succinct graph encodings.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: The black-box premise and claimed likely hardness are not an unconditional ordinary P-versus-NP or EXP-versus-NP theorem.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Pseudodeterminism and MA != NP^BPP in Communication Complexity
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: Separations for communication analogues of MA and NP^BPP, and pseudodeterministic partial-function communication.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Communication classes are not the same as language classes on Turing machines; the title supplies no ordinary MA noninclusion.

selected_primary_reviews.title: Even quantum advice is unlikely to solve PP
selected_primary_reviews.actual_scope: A repaired counting-hierarchy-collapse implication from PP contained in BQP/qpoly and fixed-degree quantum-advice circuit lower bounds.
selected_primary_reviews.roster_consequence_assessment: Fixed-degree lower bounds do not rule out the union over all polynomial sizes. The conditional collapse is not an unconditional PP versus BQP or P/poly separation.
